description: This file defines interfaces and classes for an audio server, including callback interfaces, client connection management, and server acceptance logic within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes method declarations for handling audio streams, buffers, and client connections, and references external files related to shared file descriptors, buffers, commands, and shared memory layout.

classes.name: AudioServerExecutor
classes.description: Interface for handling audio server commands and buffer events, to be implemented by classes managing audio stream operations.

classes.name: AudioClientConnection
classes.description: Manages a client connection to the audio server, including command reception, buffer handling, and event communication.

classes.name: AudioServer
classes.description: Represents the audio server that accepts client connections and manages audio streams.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new AudioClientConnection instance with specified shared memory and socket parameters.

methods.name: ReceiveCommands
methods.description: Processes incoming commands from the client, invoking appropriate executor methods.

methods.name: ReceivePlayback
methods.description: Processes incoming playback buffers from the client.

methods.name: ReceiveCapture
methods.description: Processes incoming capture buffers from the client.

methods.name: AcceptClient
methods.description: Accepts a new client connection and returns a unique pointer to an AudioClientConnection.
